events.name: Bash
events.head: Install and load keepalive launchd job
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; rg -n "[–—]" workshop-plan/ops/docker_keepalive.py workshop-plan/ops/com.tantra.docker-keepalive.plist; cp workshop-plan/ops/com.tantra.docker-keepalive.plist ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ && launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.tantra.docker-keepalive.plist; sleep 3; launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/com.tantra.docker-keepalive | grep -E "state|last exit|run interval"; cat ~/Library/Logs/tantra-docker-keepalive.log

events.text: Now the recovery test: quit Docker Desktop once and let the keepalive bring it back unaided.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Quit Docker Desktop and confirm engine is down
events.input: $ osascript -e 'quit app "Docker Desktop"' 2>&1 || osascript -e 'quit app "Docker"'; date "+quit at %H:%M:%S"; for i in $(seq 1 12); do sleep 5; /usr/local/bin/docker info --format '{{.ServerVersion}}' >/dev/null 2>&1 || { date "+engine down at %H:%M:%S"; break; }; done; pgrep -U $(id -u) -f /Applications/Docker.app/ | wc -l
